text: Bring the accepted records-history design onto this branch. Jobs 20261023-052543-9bw7 and 20261023-155649-fy1x wrote and verified it, but on a base that main later reverted, so they were abandoned. Their final text is on the branch archive/next4-2026-10-23 (read it with git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:<path>). Restore docs/design/records-history.md from there, and add its accepted decision entry (archived as D112) and its two CHANGELOG entries. Number the decision with the next free number in docs/decisions.md (D111 here) and update every reference to D112 in the design to match. Leave out everything the archive holds for the spec job (D111 there, docs/spec.toml, docs/ontology.toml, docs/enforcement.md). Otherwise keep the text as archived, except where it describes state that differs on this branch. Only docs/design/records-history.md, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md change.
